limitations: Healing efficiency is observed HP restored per positive healing action, including fountains; not hidden theoretical potion potency.
Food pressure counts observations <=25% public maximum food before a command.
Equipment rate is fraction of runs selecting an item at least once; starting loadout selections included.
Unknown coincident harm is not causal attribution.
Depth risk denominator is runs entering that depth, with unfinished runs explicitly censored; not a human survival estimate.
Failure lists are diagnostics, not proof of a rule defect. Use raw trace replay before root-cause claims.
